cases.heading: False or Misleading Benefit Presentation
cases.claim: “And in a separate analysis 99% of pregnancies were prevented per act of sex (101 pregnancies over 24,289 acts of sex).” | “Since Phexxi is an on-demand birth control, during the clinical trial, the effectiveness of Phexxi was also looked at each time Phexxi was used (per act of sex). This means Phexxi prevented pregnancy 99% of the time.”
cases.context: PI: 7-cycle cumulative pregnancy rate 13.7% (86% prevention); Pearl Index 27.5 (72.5%); disclaimer 'These data are not found in the Product Information...' does not mitigate. Bad Ad complaint received.
cases.rationale: Per-act-of-sex metric is not validated and ignores fertile window; overstates efficacy vs labeled endpoints.
cases.check: Rule: flag efficacy figures that differ from the PI's primary efficacy metric, and any claim with a 'not in the Prescribing Information' disclaimer.
